blocks.text: The Japanese beer brand marks 150 years with a Manila celebration—and a look at how it plans to carry its story forward. Sapporo’s Living Legacy A 150th birthday is reason enough to look back. For Sapporo, it was also a chance to look ahead. At the Sapporo Beer Fest at Hotel Okura Manila on September 19 and 20, the brand did something more interesting than simply recite its history. Glasses filled quickly as guests moved between Japanese dishes, freshly poured beer and a room lit by the brand’s familiar gold star. The atmosphere felt less like a museum tour and more […]...
